description: Defines data models and output structures for booking-related entities, including attendees, hosts, events, and various booking output formats, with Swagger API annotations.

classes.name: BookingAttendee
classes.description: Represents an attendee with personal details and optional contact info.

classes.name: SeatedAttendee
classes.description: Extends BookingAttendee with seat UID, booking responses, and optional metadata.

classes.name: BookingHost
classes.description: Represents a booking host with identification and contact details.

classes.name: EventType
classes.description: Represents an event type with ID and slug.

classes.name: BaseBookingOutput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Base structure for booking output, including core booking details, status, timing, and metadata.

classes.name: BookingOutput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Extended booking output including attendees, guests, and booking responses.

classes.name: RecurringBookingOutput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Booking output with recurring booking UID.

classes.name: GetRecurringSeatedBookingOutput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Seated booking output with recurring UID.

classes.name: CreateSeatedBookingOutput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Seated booking creation response with seat UID and attendees.

classes.name: CreateRecurringSeatedBookingOutput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Recurring seated booking creation response with seat UID, attendees, and recurring UID.

classes.name: ReassignedToDto
classes.description: Data transfer object for reassigned user details.

classes.name: ReassignBookingOutput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Output for reassigning a booking to another user.
